title: 第1654章 选拔大赛第1653章 宸天古城
content_zh:
身为宗门第一副宗主的柳寒山，与其余几位副宗主理念不合、权位相争，私底下矛盾颇深，面和心不和，宗门高层早已分裂为数方势力，暗流涌动。
除此之外，众人谈论最多的，便是天剑宗近日开启的全域弟子选拔大赛。
天剑宗的弟子选拔覆盖面极广，面向玄宸星域及周边所有附属星域开放，不限出身、不限籍贯，只要是年轻天骄，皆可参与角逐。消息传开，无数域外天骄纷纷奔赴而来，齐聚天剑宗剑墟擎天峰，只为争取拜入顶级宗门的机会，谋求大道前路、仙途腾飞。
听闻此言，张皓旸眸光微亮，心中瞬间生出一记绝妙计策。他手中持有三重天天剑宗宗主令牌，可直接凭令牌踏入四重天天剑宗核心地界。但如此贸然行事，太过突兀张扬，必然会引起宗门各方势力的重点关注，极易暴露行踪，引来柳寒山及其党羽的忌惮与戒备，生出诸多不必要的麻烦，不利于后续卧底探查、布局破局。
而此番全域弟子选拔，恰恰是最好的契机。若是以普通参选天骄的身份，凭自身实力通过选拔进入天剑宗，便能悄无声息融入宗门，规避所有瞩目与猜忌。
只要在选拔中脱颖而出，跻身前列，便能直接成为宗门内门乃至核心弟子，身居核心圈层，才能近距离接触宗门高层，打探到柳寒山及其党羽的核心机密，掌握更多关键证据，为后续一网打尽埋下伏笔。
心念既定，张皓旸随即收敛思绪，将自己听到的宗门纷争、弟子选拔的消息，以及想要参与选拔、卧底潜入天剑宗的完整计划，娓娓告知身侧三女。
宁馨儿、青枝、红蕊三人静静聆听，听完之后皆是神色淡然，无半分异议，全都赞同张皓旸的决断，全然放心他孤身入局。此刻四人修为早已今非昔比，底蕴远超同阶修士。
张皓旸的修为已然抵达星帝后期之境，距离星帝巅峰仅一步之遥，肉身、灵力、底蕴皆雄浑无匹，尤其神魂修为，更是早已超脱桎梏，远超星帝巅峰水准，神识浩瀚如海，洞察入微。
在四重天疆域之内，同阶无敌，纵遇星帝巅峰亦可从容应对，几乎立于不败之地。
而宁馨儿三人，得益于张皓旸所修太虚菩提道藏的菩提证道妙法滋养，修为一路突飞猛进，早已从之前的星尊巅峰，突破至星君巅峰之境。三人功法精妙、根基扎实，战力绝伦，在星帝之下，无人能接得住她们任意一人一招，同阶之内所向披靡。
正因修为突破迅猛，境界跃升过快，三人心中皆有稳固修为、打磨根基的想法，恰好可以在张皓旸忙于加入天剑宗时，她们则是要在混沌造化空间中静心闭关沉淀，夯实大道根基，打磨功法战力。
一餐饭毕，四人从容结账，在酒楼顶层预定了一间静谧的专属雅间。步入房间、布下隔绝探查的禁制之后，张皓旸抬手轻挥，灵光轻涌，便将宁馨儿、青枝、红蕊三人尽数收入混沌造化空间之中，任由三人在空间内的太初神木树下静心闭关稳固修为。
房间之内只剩张皓旸一人，他临窗而立，眺望远方天际，目光穿透层层云雾，望向天剑宗所在的剑墟方向，心中细细推演着明日弟子选拔的所有计划，斟酌每一处细节，规避所有破绽，静待明日入局。
翌日破晓，天光初露，晨曦穿透云海，洒遍苍茫星域。天色尚且微亮，东方天际刚泛起鱼肚白，张皓旸便独自动身，身形化作一道隐于虚空的流光，悄然奔赴天剑宗山门所在的剑墟擎天峰。
此时的擎天峰上下，早已人声鼎沸，盛况空前，丝毫不见拂晓的静谧。
整座擎天峰巍峨耸立，直插云霄，山势陡峭险峻，峰间剑气纵横，常年萦绕浓郁的剑道灵韵，乃是天剑宗核心选拔之地。
峰顶广袤无垠的空地上，一座座擂台整齐排布，错落有致。每一座擂台都由千年剑岩铺筑而成，坚硬无比，可承受高阶修士激战冲撞。
各座擂台之上，皆端坐着一位青衣老者，气息沉稳肃穆，修为尽数达到星尊中期境界，皆是天剑宗外派的资深执事，负责主持本次弟子选拔、评判战力高低、筛选参选天骄。
每一座擂台下方，都聚集了数万乃至数十万来自各方星域的年轻天骄，密密麻麻，排布开来，场面极为壮阔。这些千里奔赴、万里赶来的参选弟子，修为大多集中在神君、神帝之境，算是各方星域的顶尖天才，也有少数天赋更优者，突破至星尊初期、星尊中期，寥寥数人堪称天骄翘楚。

张皓旸立在人群外围，神色淡然，施展隐匿心经。一身浩瀚无垠的星帝后期修为被层层敛去，彻底压制封锁，最终只显露星尊巅峰的境界气息，完美融入一众天骄之中。
他昨日已经打探清楚天剑宗的选拔规制：寻常外门弟子，多为神君、神帝修为；内门弟子门槛，为星尊初期境界；而核心弟子，必须达到星尊后期乃至星尊巅峰方可入选。
他此刻刻意压制的星尊巅峰修为，已然稳稳站在核心弟子的入选门槛之上，只要正常发挥，便可轻松跻身核心弟子之列，届时按照宗门规制，便能拜入某位宗门高层、副宗主门下。
这种选拔弟子的方式正是柳寒山筹谋千年的算计。
他身为天剑宗第一副宗主，地位尊崇，每届弟子选拔，皆拥有优先挑选新晋顶尖弟子的资格。千年来，他凭借这一特权，屡屡截取选拔中的最优天骄，收归门下，悉心培养，不断壮大自己的势力，积攒声望与权柄，经年累月，麾下已然汇聚无数顶尖弟子，党羽众多，势力盘根错节，隐隐有凌驾宗门、独掌大权之势。
而这一切，恰好落入了张皓旸的谋划之中。
他此番参赛，便是要以绝对实力拿下本次弟子选拔的榜首之位，顺理成章被柳寒山优先选中，拜入其门下，成功卧底入局。
只有扎根柳寒山核心势力圈层，才能深入探查其所有隐秘谋划、掌控其党羽脉络，摸清其所有布局与底牌，最终等待时机成熟，将柳寒山及其一众党羽连根拔起、一网打尽。
心中计策已然周密妥帖，张皓旸抬头望向前方林立的擂台，静待这场天骄选拔大赛正式开启。

content_en:
As the first deputy sect leader of the sect, Liu Hanshan had different ideas and power struggles with the other deputy sect leaders. They had deep conflicts in private and were at odds with each other in their hearts. The senior leaders of the sect had already split into several forces, with undercurrents surging.
In addition, what everyone is talking about the most is the global disciple selection competition that Tianjian Sect has launched recently.
The Tianjian Sect's disciple selection covers a very wide range and is open to the Xuanchen Star Territory and all surrounding affiliated star territories. There is no restriction on origin or place of origin. As long as the young geniuses are young, they can participate in the competition. As the news spread, countless prodigies from outside the region rushed to gather at Tianjian Sect's Sword Ruins Qingtian Peak, just to win the opportunity to join the top sect and seek a path forward and a path to immortality.
After hearing this, Zhang Haoyang's eyes lit up slightly, and a brilliant plan instantly came into his mind. He holds the third-level Tiantian Sword Sect leader's token in his hand, and he can directly use the token to step into the core area of ​​the fourth-level Tiantian Sword Sect. However, acting so rashly and too abruptly will inevitably attract the attention of all parties in the sect and easily expose his whereabouts, attracting the fear and vigilance of Liu Hanshan and his party members, causing a lot of unnecessary troubles, and is not conducive to subsequent undercover investigations and layouts to break the situation.
And this time the selection of disciples from all over the world is exactly the best opportunity. If you enter the Tianjian Sect through selection as an ordinary prodigy and rely on your own strength, you can blend into the sect quietly and avoid all attention and suspicion.
As long as you stand out in the selection and rise to the forefront, you can directly become an inner sect or even a core disciple of the sect. Being in the core circle, you can have close contact with the sect's senior officials, find out the core secrets of Liu Hanshan and his party members, master more key evidence, and lay the groundwork for a subsequent sweep.
With his mind set, Zhang Haoyang immediately gathered his thoughts and told the three women beside him about the news about the sect disputes and disciple selection that he had heard, as well as his complete plan to participate in the selection and sneak into the Tianjian Sect undercover.
Ning Xiner, Qingzhi, and Hongrui listened quietly. After listening, they all looked calm and had no objections. They all agreed with Zhang Haoyang's decision and were completely relieved that he would enter the game alone. At this moment, the cultivation level of the four of them is already different from what it used to be, and their background is far beyond that of monks of the same level.
Zhang Haoyang's cultivation has reached the late stage of the Star Emperor, only one step away from the peak of the Star Emperor. His physical body, spiritual power, and foundation are all unparalleled. Especially his soul cultivation has already transcended the shackles and far exceeds the peak level of the Star Emperor. His spiritual consciousness is as vast as the sea and he has insight into every detail.
Within the territory of the Fourth Heaven, he is invincible at the same level. Even if he encounters the peak of the Star Emperor, he can deal with it calmly and is almost invincible.
As for Ning Xiner and the other three, thanks to the nourishment of the Bodhi Enlightenment Method of the Taixu Bodhi Tao Zang cultivated by Zhang Haoyang, their cultivation has advanced by leaps and bounds, and they have already broken through from the previous peak of Star Lord to the peak of Star Lord. The three of them have exquisite skills, solid foundations, and unparalleled fighting power. Under the Star Emperor, no one can catch any of their moves. They are invincible within the same level.
Because of the rapid breakthrough in cultivation and the rapid jump in realm, the three of them all had the idea of ​​stabilizing their cultivation and polishing their foundation. Just when Zhang Haoyang was busy joining the Tianjian Sect, they wanted to meditate in retreat in the chaotic creation space to consolidate the foundation of the avenue and polish their skills and combat power.
After finishing the meal, the four of them settled down calmly and booked a quiet, exclusive room on the top floor of the restaurant. After entering the room and setting up a ban on isolation and exploration, Zhang Haoyang raised his hand and waved lightly, and with a light surge of spiritual light, he took Ning Xiner, Qingzhi, and Hongrui into the chaotic creation space, and allowed the three of them to meditate and stabilize their cultivation under the Taichu sacred tree in the space.
Zhang Haoyang was the only one left in the room. He stood by the window and looked at the distant sky. His eyes penetrated the layers of clouds and looked towards the direction of the Sword Ruins where the Tianjian Sect was located. He was carefully deducing all the plans for tomorrow's disciple selection, considering every detail, avoiding all loopholes, and waiting for tomorrow's entry.
At dawn the next day, the sky first appeared, and the morning rays penetrated the sea of ​​clouds and spread across the vast star field. It's still darkAt dawn, as soon as the eastern sky turned fish-belly white, Zhang Haoyang stood up alone, his body turned into a stream of light hidden in the void, and quietly rushed to Jianxu Qingtian Peak, where the gate of Tianjian Sect is located.
At this time, the Qingtian Peak was already buzzing with people, the grand occasion was unprecedented, and there was no sign of the stillness of dawn.
The entire Qingtian Peak stands tall and towering, reaching straight into the sky. The mountain is steep and dangerous, and the sword energy is crisscrossed between the peaks. The strong aura of swordsmanship lingers all year round. It is the core selection place of the Tianjian Sect.
In the vast open space at the top of the peak, the arenas are arranged neatly and in a well-proportioned manner. Each arena is paved with thousand-year-old sword rocks, which are extremely hard and can withstand the fierce collisions of high-level monks.
On each stage, there is an old man in green sitting, with a calm and solemn aura. His cultivation has reached the middle stage of Star Master. They are all senior deacons sent by the Tianjian Sect. They are responsible for presiding over the selection of disciples, judging the level of combat prowess, and selecting the talented candidates.
Under each arena, tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of young talents from all star regions gathered, densely packed and arranged, the scene was extremely magnificent. Most of these disciples who have traveled thousands of miles to participate in the election are concentrated in the realm of God Lord and God Emperor. They are considered to be the top geniuses in each star field. There are also a few who have better talents and have broken through to the early stage of Star Lord and the middle stage of Star Lord. A few people can be called the outstanding geniuses.
Zhang Haoyang stood outside the crowd with a calm expression and used the Hidden Heart Sutra. The vast late-stage Star Emperor's cultivation was suppressed layer by layer, completely suppressed and blocked, and finally only the aura of the peak Star Emperor's realm was revealed, perfectly blending into the group of geniuses.
Yesterday, he had found out clearly the selection rules of Tianjian Sect: ordinary outer disciples were mostly divine kings and divine emperors; the threshold for inner disciples was the early stage of Star Lord; and the core disciples had to reach the late stage of Star Lord or even the peak of Star Lord before they could be selected.
The peak cultivation level of the Star Master that he deliberately suppressed at this moment is already firmly above the selection threshold for core disciples. As long as he performs normally, he can easily join the list of core disciples. At that time, according to the sect's regulations, he will be able to join the sect of a certain sect high-level or deputy sect leader.
This method of selecting disciples was exactly what Liu Hanshan had been planning for thousands of years.
As the first deputy sect leader of Tianjian Sect, he has a respected status and has the priority to select new top disciples in every disciple selection. For thousands of years, he has relied on this privilege to repeatedly intercept the best talents in the selection, bring them under his sect, cultivate them carefully, and continuously strengthen his power, accumulating reputation and authority. Over the years, he has gathered countless top disciples under his command, with many gang members and intricately connected forces, and he has the potential to dominate the sect and hold sole power.
And all of this happened to fall into Zhang Haoyang's plan.
He participated this time to win the first place in the disciple selection with absolute strength. It was logical that he was selected by Liu Hanshan first, became his disciple, and successfully entered the game undercover.
Only by taking root in Liu Hanshan's core power circle can we deeply explore all his secret plans, control the network of his party members, understand all his layouts and trump cards, and finally wait for the time to mature to uproot Liu Hanshan and all his party members.
With the plan in mind already well thought out, Zhang Haoyang raised his head and looked at the crowded arena in front of him, waiting for the official start of the genius selection competition.
